# <span id="aanchor403"></span> Liquid Quality Source Editor

This feature requires the **Source Analysis** module.

The Liquid Quality Source Editor is used to create, edit, or delete a liquid quality source and to manage its associated liquid analyses data. (See: [Liquid Quality Source Overview](Liquid%20Quality%20Source%20Overview.md))

<div class="procedure">

To access the Liquid Quality Source Editor:

Go to **Setup** \> **Source Analysis** \> **Liquid Quality**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 626;height: 549;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Liquid Quality Source Editor Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Liquid Quality Source Editor screen:

- **New** - Create a new source
- **Edit** - Enable edit mode
- **Delete** - Delete the selected source. Liquid sources can only be deleted from the Liquid Quality Source Editor
- **Save** - Save changes; enabled only when in new or edit mode
- **Cancel** - Cancel edits and do not changes; enabled only when in new or edit mode
- **Copy** - Copy the selected source and generates a new source, maintaining the general information from the original source
- **Exit** - Exit the screen

</div>
